game.title: The Outer Worlds 2
game.blurb: Action RPG and shooter from Obsidian Entertainment, released 2025-10-29. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From landing on Paradise Island through the Vox Relay, Alexandra Monastery and the Archive. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Companions
chapters.summary: Recruiting every companion and finishing their quests.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Hard and Very Hard, finishing without spending a bit, and other extreme outcomes.

chapters.title: Cards, Pets and Collections
chapters.summary: Pitch/Tossball cards, pets for your ship and an old acquaintance of Auntie.

chapters.title: Character, Gear and Combat
chapters.summary: Levels, skills, flaws, sneak attacks, odd weapons, selling and modifications.

chapters.title: Newer Hidden Achievements
chapters.summary: Ten hidden achievements at the end of the list that almost nobody had unlocked when checked. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1449110)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (theouterworlds.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://theouterworlds.fandom.com/wiki/The_Outer_Worlds_2
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for "The Outer Worlds 2" (also tried "The Outer Worlds II"). theouterworlds.fandom.com answers the API, with 14 linked pages, including "The Outer Worlds 2 skills", "The Outer Worlds 2 traits", "The Outer Worlds 2 flaws" and "The Outer Worlds 2 weapons"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema names the game "The Outer Worlds 2" (app 1449110, the only match in the store list). 29 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden. Achievements 49 to 58 are hidden and at 0.0% unlocked, which suggests content added after release, but nothing in the data names it; they get their own chapter by name. Four hidden ones ("SA Quarterlies Quantified", "Golden Ridge Murals In Plural", "Praetor Towers Powered", "Cloister Excogitation Logs CEL-ebration") sound like collection goals but have no descriptions, so they stay in the main story chapter as a placeholder, as do the other hidden ones. "Auntie's Old Acquaintance" (Met Amos) was put with the collections by guess.
